Two Central-European series exist and differ by ~20–35%: myCEPPI (weekly, market price from processors/distributors/producers, EUR/t, ~5-week delay) and Plastech.pl (monthly average OFFER price, PLN/kg; e.g. PP homo 6.84 v myCEPPI 5.11; ABS 9.82 v 8.03). Commodity values here use myCEPPI (closer to what an automotive tier buying direct pays); Plastech is given as the small-lot / distributor upper reference. Only POM uses Plastech (no other source).
Engineering resins without a CEE market series (PC, PA6, PA66, PBT, PET, PMMA, EPDM, NBR) use businessanalytiq Europe indices (aggregator; method not published in detail) — moderate confidence.

Method limit: plasticker.de, plasticportal.eu, plastech.pl and the other price sites could not be fetched from this sandbox (egress refused); every figure was read from search-engine extracts of the cited pages. 30 web searches used.

Context: European polymer prices are ~15–20% higher y/y after the Q2 2026 ethylene spike (April ethylene contract +€450 to €1,595/t); KI reports engineering thermoplastics softening broadly in Sep 2026; Celanese POM (8 Oct) and Trinseo PMMA (+€250/t, 1 Oct) increases announced.

Current-book figures that look wrong: mat-upvc-pipe 3.97 (uPVC K67 dry-blend compound) is BELOW the S-PVC resin itself (4.34) — a compound cannot cost less than its resin; mat-pa66 12.61 is low v 16.28 (businessanalytiq) / 17.71 (tworzywa.pl EU) — ~25% low; mat-pmma 11.86 is low v 14.20 (+Trinseo Oct increase); mat-pet-bg 5.91 / mat-pet-preform 6.18 are high v 4.97 (businessanalytiq Sep) / 5.49 (IMARC Q2); mat-hips 6.69 = GPPS but HIPS trades ~140 EUR/t above GPPS (7.33 v 6.71); mat-pp-homo 4.83 a little low v 5.11 and mat-pp-impact 5.08 low v PP-copo 5.68; mat-ldpe 5.32 v 5.58 and mat-lldpe 5.13 v 5.45 slightly low; mat-pa66gf30 15.32 sits below the unfilled PA66 evidence (no compound price found to confirm). Close to evidence: mat-abs 8.01 (8.03), mat-gpps 6.69 (6.71), mat-pc 12.46 (11.55–14.40), mat-pa6 10.82 (10.28), mat-pbt 13.35 (14.24), mat-nr 9.64 (9.97 FOB Asia), mat-peek 384.58 (Victrex ASP 346.5, all-mix).

Rubber book grades are 'xx Shore A' compounds (fillers, oil, curatives, mixing) and are not directly comparable with the raw-polymer prices here (e.g. EPDM polymer 12.39 v book EPDM 70A compound 9.61 — plausible for a highly filled compound).

Not found: TPU, PA66-GF30 / PA6-GF30 / PP-GF30 / PP-talc compound prices, carbon fibre T700, glass roving (Europe), polyester powder coating, September/October European ethylene/propylene contract settlements.
